title: ALASKA
technologies: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, PgBouncer, Socket.IO, Docker
bullets: Engineered a \textbf{route-based social networking platform} that enables \textbf{real-time discovery}, connecting users who share overlapping metro commutes.

Developed an interactive custom metro route builder using \textbf{Mapbox GL JS} and \textbf{Dijkstra's algorithm}, computing optimal shortest paths across a network of 250+ interconnected nodes in real-time.

Optimized subpath matching by implementing a \textbf{Suffix Graph}, reducing time complexity from quadratic to $\mathcal{O}(N \times L)$ and offloading generation to the client to eliminate server-side preprocessing overhead.

Built a scalable \textbf{real-time chat system} utilizing a \textbf{Gateway-Worker-Queue pattern} with \textbf{Socket.IO and Redis}, decoupling connections from database writes to ensure message delivery during high traffic spikes.

title: CORTEX
technologies: Python, PyQt6, Pydantic, NetworkX, LLM, PyAutoGUI
bullets: Built an \textbf{OS-level automation engine} using \textbf{PyAutoGUI} to interact with complex EHR systems, enabling seamless data entry workflows across iframe-heavy web portals and legacy desktop apps where standard DOM scraping fails.

Transformed script-based bot creation into a visual workflow by developing a custom \textbf{drag-and-drop node interface} using \textbf{PyQt6 and NetworkX}, allowing non-technical users to visually build complex \textbf{automation pipelines (DAGs)}.

Reduced UI-update breakages by integrating \textbf{self-healing image locators} powered by \textbf{Vision LLMs}, enabling the system to dynamically identify and interact with elements despite layout shifts or varying screen resolutions.
